DataFitPolicy.description:
Thresholds the data-fit check applies before a strategy is allowed to run.

Attributes:
    min_decisions_base: The `30` in the sample-minimum rule `max(30, 30 / (1 -
        holdout_fraction))`.
    edge_tolerance_sessions: Matches the data audit's `edge_gap.max_edge_gap_sessions`; for a
        prediction market the count is calendar days against the window's first and last event.
    power_calibration_constant: The `z_power + z_alpha` of the power rule
        (`edgelab.data.fit._min_detectable_sharpe`).
    max_min_detectable_sharpe: The only power-based failure: if the window's bars, bars per year
        and trial count imply a minimum detectable annual Sharpe above this, the run is refused;
        below it the report discloses the number.

edge_tolerance_sessions.description: Expected sessions (or, for a prediction market, calendar days) an instrument's data may start late or end early before the span rule fails.
edge_tolerance_sessions.title: Edge Tolerance Sessions

max_min_detectable_sharpe.description: Ceiling on the minimum annual Sharpe ratio the tested window could actually detect; above it, the run is refused as pointless.
max_min_detectable_sharpe.title: Max Min Detectable Sharpe

min_decisions_base.description: The constant used on both sides of max(30, 30 / (1 - holdout_fraction)): an absolute floor on tested decisions and the numerator scaled by holdout fraction.
min_decisions_base.title: Min Decisions Base

min_density.description: Minimum ratio of distinct trading dates to expected sessions.
min_density.title: Min Density

power_calibration_constant.description: The power rule's calibration constant (z_power + z_alpha).
power_calibration_constant.title: Power Calibration Constant

power_table_reference.description: Identifier of the power table the minimum-detectable-Sharpe reads from.
power_table_reference.title: Power Table Reference

ExecutionPolicy.description:
How a decision becomes a fill, and the frictions applied on top.

Attributes:
    option_fill_fraction: Fraction of the half-spread an option order pays from the mid toward
        the adverse quote (`1.0` fills at the full bid/ask).
    option_max_quote_age_bars: Maximum age of the option-chain snapshot an order may fill
        against;
        `0` allows only the fill bar's own snapshot, `None` places no limit.
    option_max_iv_age_bars: A data-quality tolerance, not a strategy choice.
    prediction_market_max_quote_age_bars: As `option_max_quote_age_bars`, for order books.
    prediction_market_max_participation_frac: Largest share of each order-book level's quoted
        size one prediction-market order may take; the rest of the order walks deeper levels
        and what no level gives stays unfilled. `1.0` takes whole levels.
    prediction_market_fee_scale: Multiplier on every prediction-market fee, whatever the
        market's fee formula; `1.0` charges the formula as it stands.
    max_adv_participation: Fill-time cap, not a strategy choice.
    successor_wait_sessions: Sessions after its effective date a successor conversion waits
        for the successor's first bar; with none by then the holding ends as an unexplained
        end at its mark.

decision_delay_trading_days.description: Trading days between the decision and the earliest fillable bar, used instead of decision_delay_bars for a coarse (weekly/monthly/quarterly) schedule. Must be at least 1.

max_adv_participation.title: Max Adv Participation

GatePolicy.description:
Thresholds for the evidence scorecard that produces the final verdict.

Attributes:
    max_pbo_red: Must be at least `max_pbo_green`.
    amber_band: Fraction of a threshold's magnitude a failing value may fall within and still be
        amber rather than red.
    min_survivorship_coverage: Below this the verdict caps the label at Insufficient evidence.
    dsr_trial_variance: Which variance scales the Deflated Sharpe hurdle: `"family"` (the
        sample variance of the searched trials' Sharpe ratios) or `"no_skill"` (the sampling
        variance of a Sharpe ratio under no skill, `1 / (T - 1)`). The family dispersion
        includes the tested trial, so a trial with a real edge raises its own hurdle.
        Optional: a block may omit it and takes `DEFAULT_DSR_TRIAL_VARIANCE`, and a block
        holding the default dumps without it, so a block that omits it and one that states
        the default are the same values.
    min_worthwhile_sharpe: Smallest annual Sharpe ratio worth trading. A run whose Sharpe
        ratio is bounded above by less than this, with 95% confidence, has no edge worth
        trading. Optional like `dsr_trial_variance`: a block holding
        `DEFAULT_MIN_WORTHWHILE_SHARPE` dumps without it.
    min_factor_coverage: Smallest share of the live window's calendar periods that the factor
        data must cover for the factor regression to run; below it factor attribution is not
        evaluated. Optional like `dsr_trial_variance`: a block holding
        `DEFAULT_MIN_FACTOR_COVERAGE` dumps without it.
    min_beta_bars: Live bars for which an `alpha` hypothesis deducts a symbol or universe
        benchmark whole before it scales it by the past-only beta (the OLS slope of net on
        benchmark over the live bars before the bar). Optional like `dsr_trial_variance`: a
        block holding `DEFAULT_MIN_BETA_BARS` dumps without it.

amber_band.description: Fraction of a threshold's magnitude a failing value may still fall within and be amber.
amber_band.title: Amber Band

cpcv_percentile.description: Percentile of the CPCV OOS Sharpe distribution that must be positive.
cpcv_percentile.title: Cpcv Percentile

dsr_trial_variance.description: Variance that scales the Deflated Sharpe hurdle: 'family' is the dispersion of the searched trials' Sharpe ratios; 'no_skill' is the sampling variance of a Sharpe ratio under no skill, 1 / (T - 1), which a real edge in the family cannot raise.
dsr_trial_variance.title: Dsr Trial Variance

max_calibration_p.description: Maximum bootstrap p-value for a prediction-market model's Brier score to count as significantly below the market's.
max_calibration_p.title: Max Calibration P

max_pbo_green.description: PBO below which the gate is green.
max_pbo_green.title: Max Pbo Green

max_pbo_red.description: PBO above which the gate is red.
max_pbo_red.title: Max Pbo Red

max_random_entry_p.description: Maximum acceptable p-value from the random-entry placebo test.
max_random_entry_p.title: Max Random Entry P

min_active_bars.description: Minimum live bars with a non-zero gross return before any inference gate reports a number.
min_active_bars.title: Min Active Bars

min_beta_bars.description: Live bars for which an alpha hypothesis deducts a market benchmark whole before scaling it by the past-only beta.
min_beta_bars.title: Min Beta Bars

min_breakeven_cost_multiple.description: Minimum multiple of assumed costs the strategy must withstand.
min_breakeven_cost_multiple.title: Min Breakeven Cost Multiple

min_delay_sharpe_retention.description: Minimum fraction of base-case Sharpe retained after +1 bar delay.
min_delay_sharpe_retention.title: Min Delay Sharpe Retention

min_factor_alpha_t.description: Minimum HAC t-statistic of the factor-model alpha.
min_factor_alpha_t.title: Min Factor Alpha T

min_factor_coverage.description: Smallest share of the live window's calendar periods the factor data must cover for the factor regression to run; below it factor attribution is not evaluated.
min_factor_coverage.title: Min Factor Coverage

min_hac_t_multiple.description: Minimum HAC t-statistic of mean net excess return when trials > 1.
min_hac_t_multiple.title: Min Hac T Multiple

min_hac_t_single.description: Minimum HAC t-statistic for a genuinely single pre-registered trial.
min_hac_t_single.title: Min Hac T Single

min_psr.description: Minimum Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio against SR* = 0.
min_psr.title: Min Psr

min_round_trips.description: Minimum bets before any inference gate reports a number.
min_round_trips.title: Min Round Trips

min_survivorship_coverage.description: Minimum share of an index universe's ex-members with prices through their removal.
min_survivorship_coverage.title: Min Survivorship Coverage

min_worthwhile_sharpe.description: Smallest annual Sharpe ratio worth trading; a run whose 95% upper bound on the Sharpe ratio is below it shows no edge worth trading.
min_worthwhile_sharpe.title: Min Worthwhile Sharpe

require_holdout_positive.description: Whether the locked holdout return must be positive.
require_holdout_positive.title: Require Holdout Positive

require_min_trl.description: Whether the track record must reach the implied Minimum Track Record Length.
require_min_trl.title: Require Min Trl
